description: RAML 1.0 document with exactly one blocking defect: the Pet example's id is a string where the type says integer. amf_validation is what the real amf 5.7.1 `validate` reported for this document.
document:
#%RAML 1.0
title: Shelter API
version: v1
types:
  Pet:
    type: object
    properties:
      id: integer
    example:
      id: "not-a-number"
/pets:
  get:
    responses:
      200:
        body:
          application/json:
            type: Pet[]
